parameters.name: RewriteQueryStringType
parameters.description:
The query string rewrite type. Valid values:

- static: static mode.
- dynamic: dynamic mode.

parameters.name: RewriteUriType
parameters.description:
The URI rewrite type. Valid values:

- static: static mode.
- dynamic: dynamic mode.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content, which uses conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter does not need to be set when adding global configurations. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
The rule switch. This parameter does not need to be set when adding global configurations. Valid values:
- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter does not need to be set when adding global configurations.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0.
